-- Store sales including VAT, before returns, for August and September 2024
-- Using web dispatch date for web orders, sale date for store orders
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
sales_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date,
           f.gross_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND YEAR(COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date)) = 2024
    AND MONTH(COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date)) IN (8, 9)
)
SELECT 
    YEAR(business_date) AS year,
    MONTH(business_date) AS month,
    SUM(gross_amount) AS gross_sales_incl_vat
FROM sales_lines
GROUP BY YEAR(business_date), MONTH(business_date)
ORDER BY year, month;

-- Check: store sales (physical stores only) vs web sales
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
sales_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date,
           s.store_id,
           f.gross_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND YEAR(COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date)) = 2024
    AND MONTH(COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date)) IN (8, 9)
)
SELECT 
    MONTH(business_date) AS month,
    CASE WHEN store_id < 900 THEN 'Physical Stores' WHEN store_id = 900 THEN 'Web' ELSE 'Other' END AS channel,
    SUM(gross_amount) AS gross_sales_incl_vat
FROM sales_lines
WHERE store_id <> 999
GROUP BY MONTH(business_date), store_id
ORDER BY month, store_id;

-- Check data coverage: number of sales lines, receipts, and stores in August and September 2024
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
sales_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date,
           s.store_id,
           f.receipt_id,
           f.gross_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND YEAR(COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date)) = 2024
    AND MONTH(COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date)) IN (8, 9)
)
SELECT 
    MONTH(business_date) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipt_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS store_count,
    SUM(gross_amount) AS total_gross_incl_vat
FROM sales_lines
GROUP BY MONTH(business_date)
ORDER BY month;
